title: Late Cancellation Fee Amount — Bluegate Moving Truck Rental
content:
**Tariff clause.** The late cancellation fee of a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental reservation is the flat late cancellation fee figure of the vehicle class reserved, as shown on the class cancellation and no-show fee table, rounded to the cent once, on the final amount.

The vehicle class reserved is the class standing on the reservation record when it is cancelled.

## Worked figures (hypothetical reservations cancelled late)

| Vehicle class reserved | Flat late cancellation fee figure (USD) | Late cancellation fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Pickup Truck | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck | 50.00 | 50.00 |

A reservation first made for a Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck and changed to a Bluegate Pickup Truck before it was cancelled is charged on the Bluegate Pickup Truck figure, since that is the class reserved at cancellation.
